experiments.H0: Positive control (ANALYSIS G): replay the stock's recorded start feed (route-01.payload.json with a fresh pathId, matched position, TrafficInfo class 9 / spdLmt 0, status 101, region 990001, light 1, historySpeed 25) through the guarded publisher. Parked.
experiments.H1: Frame: the same Yandex route twice, WGS84 vs NATIVE_GCJ_UNRESTRICTED_CANDIDATE for route and positions. Parked.
experiments.H2: Attributes: with the frame fixed, add class 9, ownership 0, adminCode/region 990001, TrafficInfo class 9, position ownership 0, one at a time. Parked; the highway (class 6) part is D-HWY.
experiments.H3: The P->D transient: gate-reader latency past the 2.5 s TTL or SLEEP_STATUS; run AdasGateReader read-only at >= 5 Hz over three P->D shifts.
experiments.H4: Route churn: parked, publish the same route 3x 10 s apart; driving, freeze the link table on the stock+OSM city-NOA street (D-CITY).
experiments.H5: Rates and field values: throttle to 1 Hz with stock values; low priority.
experiments.H6: Queue overflow on the starved worker: host harness first.
experiments.D-HWY: Supervised highway drive on М-3 (where stock+OSM got HNOA): class 6/0, formway 1, direction 1, lane count, ramp distance.
experiments.D-CITY: Supervised drive on the stock+OSM city-NOA street with a frozen link table (H4 driving part).
experiments.BENCH-FB: Host only: find or record the case on the Beijing factory bench (stock_trace.py on an emulator, compare.py) and read what the stock sends.
experiments.RE-LM: Corpus-first: read the decompiled BydLaunchermap/SDK enum or rule (tools/firmware_corpus.py find) before choosing a value.
experiments.ALIGN-STOCK: No experiment needed: the stock rule is recovered; the decision is to mirror it, checked by the bench differential.
experiments.TRACE-SIDE: Corpus-first trace of the side channel's recipients, then a read-only property read during a stock navigation; no write.
experiments.P-CLOSE: Parked: arm, publish, close guarded; observe whether ADAS releases the path; then compare with the stock stop sequence (status 100, pathId -1).
experiments.EMU: Our own emulator AVD: replay the input case through Navigator in dry run.
